goal.text: Leave home safely after the earthquake.

intro.text: Your family must leave the house. What do you bring?

hint.text: What did your family pack for 3 days?

lesson.text: Bring your go bag and walk out. Expect aftershocks.

choices.label: Leave without the go bag
choices.heading: Not ready yet
choices.feedback: Your go bag has what you need. Bring it with you.

choices.label: Run back in for your toys
choices.heading: Not safe yet
choices.feedback: Do not go back in. Aftershocks can come. Walk out now.

choices.label: Leave without a note
choices.heading: Not ready yet
choices.feedback: Leave a message so others know where you went.

choices.label: Grab the go bag and walk out
choices.feedback: Bring the go bag. Leave a note saying where you went.
